description: Check whether repo memory, code graph, memory graph, and stale-memory state are ready for merge. Leads with a human summary of team memories invalidated by the current change — relay it to the developer. On a repo with many stale packets, validation findings, or reconciliation items, those lists are each capped to the 10 most actionable entries by default (stale packets ranked by urgency), with true totals and truncation notes; pass limit or verbose for more.

limit.description: Max entries per capped list to return (default 10 each).

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

verbose.description: Return every entry in every list, uncapped.

name: kage_pr_check
